role: Post-result diagnosis only; no fitting, controller tuning, arm selection or new control trials.
questions: How often did issued commands leave the per-channel ranges actually used in training?
Do first-step prediction errors and all tracking outcomes independently replay?
How different are normalized-command Jacobians at the shared initial observation and trim command?
limitations: Marginal command ranges are not joint support or uncertainty. Derivative mismatch and coverage may coexist; these checks do not isolate one cause.
